senses.gloss: m. (יָצַק) uninterrupted flow of a liquid poured from vessel to vessel.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 8:9">Toh. VIII, 9</cite> <he>הנ׳ … אינן חבור וכ׳</he> an uninterrupted flow, a current on slanting ground and …, are not considered a connection (of the two liquids) either for communicating uncleanness or for producing cleanness.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 56b:3">Ab. Zar. 56ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>נ׳ חיבור</he>, v. <cite ref="H00658"><he>חִיבּוּר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Nazir 50b:3">Naz. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>יש נ׳ לאוכלין וכ׳</he> does, or does not, the law regarding a connected flow apply to eatable things (e.g. melted fat)?; a. fr.
